<thought>Since the template search with both broken functional groups returned no results, I will broaden the criteria to only require breaking a ketone (the carbonyl) and forming an aliphatic hydroxyl, which should still capture carbonyl‑ene templates. This broader search is more likely to return a matching template.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
